beats.action: A black screen with white text "NORTH STUDIO" appears. The text slowly expands, then contracts slightly. The phrase then smoothly transitions into the next beat.
beats.sound: A subtle, expanding synth pad fades in and holds.

beats.action: A white square appears in the center of a black screen. It stretches horizontally, becoming a thin white line that spans the width of the screen. The line holds its position.
beats.sound: A gentle, continuous electronic hum with a slight upward inflection.

beats.action: The thin white line from the previous beat begins to undulate, forming a smooth, repeating wave pattern across the screen. The wave moves fluidly from left to right.
beats.sound: A soft, rhythmic whoosh sound, echoing the wave's movement.

beats.action: The waving line gradually fades out as "NORTH STUDIO" text reappears on a black screen. The text settles in the center, bold and clear. It remains on screen.
beats.sound: The synth pad from the first beat returns, holding steadily before fading out completely.
